outcome: Readiness of Ethiopian health care facilities to manage preeclampsia and eclampsia
cohort: 3804 health facilities in Ethiopia that provided delivery services
finding: There were notable gaps in readiness of facilities in detection and management of preeclampsia/eclampsia in Ethiopia, including poor availability of essential supplies, medications, and referrals, as well as a lack of training on preeclampsia/eclampsia management among healthcare providers.
